firstMessage:
Updated [Sessions.login](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.rules.ts-shop.T14.3/repo/src/accounts.ts:93) to compute the password hash before checking the lock. A locked login now incurs the same slow hash operation as a wrong-password attempt.
